To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) PGE1 stimulates Na+, K+ ATPase activity in MDCK cells, (2) this effect is mediated by an increase in cyclic AMP, and (3) the effect of PGE1 can be explained either in terms of an increase in the Na+ pump number or an increase in the pump's efficiency.
PGE1 and cyclic AMP stimulate the Na+, K+-ATPase in the MDCK cell line by an increase in Na+,K+-ATPase activity and number of active Na+,K+-pumps.
PGE1 increases the number of oua­bain‐binding sites, and the Vmax for Rb+ uptake via ouabain‐binding sites in MDCK cells.

the role of prostaglandins and cyclic AMP in regulating the activity and number of Na+, K+ pumps in MDCK cells.
